description: This file defines classes and utilities related to model parameters and buffers in PyTorch, including Parameter, UninitializedParameter, Buffer, UninitializedBuffer, and associated metaclasses and mixins.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: A subclass of torch.Tensor representing a module parameter with special registration behavior.

classes.name: UninitializedParameter
classes.description: A parameter that is not initialized, holding no data until materialized.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A subclass of torch.Tensor representing a module buffer that is not a parameter.

classes.name: UninitializedBuffer
classes.description: A buffer that is not initialized, similar to UninitializedParameter.

classes.name: _ParameterMeta
classes.description: Metaclass to customize isinstance checks for Parameter.

classes.name: _BufferMeta
classes.description: Metaclass to customize isinstance checks for Buffer.

classes.name: UninitializedTensorMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing methods for uninitialized tensors/buffers.

methods.name: is_lazy
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is an uninitialized tensor or buffer.
